bullets.text: Serve as one of two frontend engineers on a cross-functional team building a policy alignment platform that centralizes organizational policy ingestion, giving each user a personal dashboard to manage documents and launch AI-driven assessments.
Build React interfaces surfacing AI-generated alignment scores and recommendation text that help users compare uploaded documents against defined regulatory and industry-standard criteria.
Partner with a Python GenAI services team (assessment/scoring engine) and a Java team (document and application services) to ship assessment workflows end-to-end.
Contribute to LLM-based agent workflows that orchestrate assessment kickoff, result generation, and downstream remediation planning.

Designed, implemented, and tested a micro-frontend Angular module within a 20+ MFE ecosystem using Webpack Module Federation, integrating 8+ backend microservices and improving load performance ~35% through caching and optimized API orchestration.
Engineered a configurable approval workflow engine supporting 5 stages, 8 roles, and granular permissions — enabling full auditability and regulatory compliance for enterprise reporting.

Built reusable UI framework components (dashboards, tables, modals) and a role-based entitlement system (50+ mapped actions), maintaining 90%+ Jest test coverage through unit and integration testing, and contributing to framework upgrades and codebase refactoring.

Developed Angular dashboards with responsive, accessible UI for reconciliation validation across financial systems, supporting 500+ Risk & Compliance users in detecting data discrepancies and breach scenarios.

Connected front-end features to back-end systems via RESTful API integrations; implemented transaction-level drill-down views and execution controls, handling error responses and edge cases to maintain product stability.

Built mobility control protocol logic enabling seamless handoff between visible-light transmitters with zero perceptible data loss; contributed to low-level debugging and performance testing in a real-time networking environment.
Developed kernel-level networking components using Rust and eBPF to optimize packet handling and latency for hybrid Wi-Fi/light-based communication systems.
Built personal projects using React, focusing on component-based UI development, state management, and integration testing — applying front-end fundamentals outside of core work responsibilities.
Selected for UC Berkeley SkyDeck accelerator (Sep 2024 cohort), collaborating with researchers and industry mentors.
